thesis: Mohnish Pabrai argues that while he initially focused on compounders from 1994 to 1999, he switched to deep value investing in 1999 to avoid the dot-com bubble and remained in that style until 2020. He states that after reading about Nick Sleep and Zach in William Green's book in 2020, he realized he needed to return to investing in great growing businesses, but only when purchased at a price well below their value, noting that buying great businesses at 80 times earnings is not a great way to get rich.
